query_chat_completion: query the Hugging Face chat completions API with a messages payload and model name
send_user_message: send a user message to an LLM model via the Hugging Face router API
extract_response_message: extract the assistant message from a chat completion API response
configure_api_headers: configure Bearer token authorization headers for the Hugging Face API
post_chat_payload: post a chat completion payload to the Hugging Face completions endpoint
